data_relationships.builds_reference_items: wr_meta_builds_v3.json core_items/situational → wr_items_v3.json by item name
data_relationships.builds_reference_runes: wr_meta_builds_v3.json runes → wr_runes.json by rune name
data_relationships.builds_reference_spells: wr_meta_builds_v3.json spells → wr_summoner_spells_v3.json by spell name
data_relationships.synergy_references_champions: wr_synergy_engine_v3.json champion pairs → wr_champions_v3.json by champion_id
data_relationships.counter_references_champions: wr_counter_engine_v3.json matchups → wr_champions_v3.json by champion name
data_relationships.comps_reference_all: wr_team_comps_v3.json roles → builds, synergy, counter engines

steps: 1. User selects champion + role (or asks question)
2. Context Assembler pulls relevant data from JSON databases
3. Pre-Build Response fills template with DB data (items, runes, stats)
4. AI Provider generates rationale/reasoning for [AI: ...] sections
5. Validator checks for hallucination (missing rune/spell rationale, fake stats)
6. Response Merger combines DB data + AI reasoning
7. UI renders structured response with glassmorphism cards
data_flow.diagram: User → Query Parser → Context Assembler → [JSON DBs] → Pre-Build → AI Provider → Validator → Response → UI

provider_cascade.description: Try providers in order. Fall back to next on failure/timeout.

reasoning_flow: context_assembly: load relevant JSON data for the query
pre_build_response: fill structured template with hard DB data
ai_rationale: AI fills ONLY the [AI: reasoning] sections
validation: check for hallucinated stats, missing rationale, confidence
response: merge DB data + AI reasoning → structured JSON response

high.criteria: Data fully in DB. AI only adds reasoning on known facts.

medium.criteria: Partial DB data. AI infers from patterns. Flag as medium.

low.criteria: No DB data. AI speculates. Clearly warn user.

hallucination_guards: NEVER generate item stats — always pull from wr_items_v3.json
NEVER generate rune descriptions — always pull from wr_runes.json
NEVER invent champion abilities — always pull from wr_champions_v3.json
AI fills ONLY [AI: rationale] sections — never modifies DB data
Validator checks: if AI mentions stat not in DB → flag and remove
Confidence: if AI reasoning contradicts DB data → override with DB
Response includes data_source field: 'db' for hard data, 'ai' for reasoning

synergy_engine.description: Analyze team synergies between picked champions
synergy_engine.ai_role: Score team synergy. Suggest swaps to improve synergy.

counter_engine.ai_role: Recommend counter picks with lane-specific advice.

comp_advisor.description: Team composition suggestions and draft guidance
comp_advisor.ai_role: Suggest comp templates. Explain win conditions. Adapt to draft state.

macro_coach.description: Game phase advice: early/mid/late game macro strategy
macro_coach.ai_role: Advise on lane phase, objective priority, teamfight positioning, wave management.

stat_calculator.description: Real-time stat calculator with items/runes/spells and level slider 1-15
stat_calculator.ai_role: No AI needed — pure math engine with compounding stat formulas.

learning_paths.description: Champion mastery progression guides, role transitions, autofill guides
learning_paths.ai_role: Generate personalized learning milestones based on player champion pool.

api_routes.returns: Build with items, runes, spells, skill order + AI rationale
Synergy score + pair synergies + comp pattern match
Comp suggestions + draft advice + win condition
Health check for all AI providers + latency
Calculated stats at given level with items/runes
